_comment: Step 9: every string a user reads, in English (the fallback for every other language). Keys must exist in en; other languages may only use keys that exist here (worker/test/i18n.test.mjs lists missing and extra keys). {name} style placeholders are filled by code. Plural forms: en/fr/hy one+other, ru one+few+many. Never an em or en dash.

⭐ A tip is voluntary and unlocks nothing.

Right here in Telegram.
At the times you pick.
Free for everyone.

AI groups and scores the stories.

Axiom is free.
Like it? Leave a tip in Telegram Stars.

Nothing is sold or shared.
